criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: S3 tray reads at declared scale; S1 engine and S2 tape each one lit subject. S4 bars unlabelled with stray springs and a dead lower zone, S7 does not resolve into an inspection, S6 tick strip unexplained, S5 rail abstract at thumb size. S2, S4 to S7 share one flat ultramarine field.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One palette, one type system, gold as the measured thing, the engine bookends S1, S7, S9. S8 beige relief breaks the run; value arc flat across S4 to S7.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces to figures.json and a claim; testing caveat carried. Single-source release; S7 leans on c15 background line; S1 body credits AVX with building both tools while c7 credits the PSV to Texas Tech.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: Close to a topic rather than a story. No decision, recipient or funder named; S9 watch line names no body or document; Texas stake arrives late on S8.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: S2 to S3 pays off; S3 to S5 three figure frames at the same weight; S8 backstory before the close; cover states a fact without a reason to swipe.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean house style, reads as a release paraphrase; S4 kicker filler; caption misdirection hook.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Fresh subject, familiar v2 explainer look, counted grid and county relief familiar moves.

one_sentence_fix: Name the funder (c1) early, fold S4 into S3, and make S9 name a concrete thing to watch or say none is public.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Bars unlabelled, stray springs, background scribbles, dead lower third.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Accent pills 'volume' and 'files' on the bars, delete springs and line noise, lower the camera so the bars fill to the headline.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Tray, probe and part do not read as an inspection at feed size.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Push onto the tray and add a gloved hand touching the part, matte gold band.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Gold tick strip unexplained, flat key across blades.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Make the strip a partly filled life gauge, rake the key from the right.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Diagonal rail reads abstract at thumb size, pill floats.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Rotate the rail toward horizontal, seat the tab at a visible 480 tick with the pill on it.
